technique_name: Give an example of a market opportunity with blockchain technology.
description: Blockchain technology provides a number of opportunities in the market. One example is the banking and finance sector, where blockchain technology can be used to streamline banking transactions such as money transfers and payments. This technology can also be used to improve security and reduce fraud, as the data is stored in a secure, immutable ledger.
